# Bilal Shafqat

> One-person digital marketing, design, and development studio based in Dubai, UAE, with 15+ years of experience. Bilal personally handles paid marketing, performance marketing, web and mobile development, graphic design, and social media management for clients across the UAE and worldwide, without agency handoffs between departments.

## Who this is for

Startups and founders, real estate developers and agencies (UAE), in-house teams and growing companies, and agencies or consulting partners who need reliable delivery on marketing, design, or development work.

## Services

- Paid Marketing (Google & Social)
- Performance Marketing
- Web Design & Development
- MERN Stack Development
- Mobile App Development
- Graphic Design
- Social Media Management

## Engagement models

- Project-Based: a defined deliverable with a clear scope, timeline, and price.
- Monthly Retainer: ongoing marketing, design, or development support on a recurring basis.
- Ongoing Partner / Dedicated Support: embedded support alongside a client's team for larger initiatives.
- Consulting & Advisory: high-level review and guidance focused on clarity and measurable outcomes.
